text:
mia: Heads-up — bringing up sakura-v2 int8 on staging, and we see two weird locale failures in the smoke evals.

tao: what kind of failures? logs?

mia: quick summary: 1) Japanese keigo/honorific translations are getting more informal, BLEU/COMET down on our keigo-prompts set. 2) Arabic bilingual samples show bracket orientation flipping ("(" vs ")") and truncation around RTL-LTR boundaries.

sasha: hmm. are both reproducible on CPU fallback or only on int8 runtime?

mia: only on int8 kernels so far. CPU fp32 and q8s look fine. Ran a small bisect: happens when we use the new matmul-kernel v3 and the fused softmax rewrite.

jun: can you paste the eval snippet/results?

mia: sure — sample metrics from the keigo set (ja->en, polite-honorific-preserve subset):

```
Model: sakura-v2 fp32: BLEU=31.8, COMET=0.42
Model: sakura-v2 int8: BLEU=27.4, COMET=0.18
Delta: BLEU -4.4, COMET -0.24
```

mia: Example input: "先生がお読みになりますか？"
mia: fp32 output: "Will the teacher read it? (honorific preserved)"
mia: int8 output: "Does the teacher read it?" (lost honorific nuance)

luis: yikes. any tokenization diffs between fp32 and int8 runs? token counts, byte offsets?

mia: token counts identical. But we see more early stop tokens and truncated suffixes in multi-sentence inputs for RTL mixed examples.

tao: show Arabic example pls

mia: Arabic source: "هل يمكنني استخدام (API) الآن؟"

mia: fp32: "Can I use (API) now?"
mia: int8: "Can I use )API( now?"  <-- bracket order flipped and sometimes the trailing punctuation drops

sasha: that bracket flip smells like bidi reordering happening at detokenize or postprocess step after generation. Could int8 kernel be changing token ID ordering (e.g., off-by-one in KV cache pop)?

jun: check KV cache indices and the dequantize path. We had a recent micro-optim that changed attention-index layout for v3 kernel.

luis: also validate detokenizer: sometimes the detok uses unicode-bidi heuristics that depend on placeholder tokens. If placeholder tokens get split differently (diff token boundaries because of different logits), detok outcome changes.

mia: i ran a quick trace with debug tokens — ordering in the raw token ids from the model is different for the problematic lines. Example token id sequence snippet (fp32 vs int8):

```
fp32 ids: [3452, 77, 102, 9001, 23]
int8 ids: [3452, 77, 102, 9001, 23, 0]
```

mia: int8 often emits an extra nul-like token 0 between punctuation and adjacent token in mixed-dir contexts.

tao: extra 0 token -> causes detok to treat boundary as separate, bidi algorithm reorders parens -> visible flip. Where does 0 come from? EOS masking bug? quantized softmax overflow?

sasha: probable root candidates: 1) fused-softmax quantization saturation, 2) KV cache index pointer wrap for long prefix with mixed bidi, 3) postprocess trimming step mis-detecting short sequences.

jun: let's do a quick repro script. Can someone run `./scripts/repro_int8_locale.sh --model sakura-v2 --input tests/keigo-rtl.json` and attach logs here?

mia: running now, attaching minimal output: (pasted)

```
[repro] model=sakura-v2 int8
[repro] input=tests/keigo-rtl.json
[repro] generated_ids: ... 9001, 23, 0, 2
[repro] detok-> "Can I use )API( now?"
```

deploy-bot: snapshot deployed to staging-int8-2026-03-21-171999

luis: thanks. I'll add a quick unit that filters out size-0 tokens before detok as a guard, but that's bandaid. Need root fix in runtime.

tao: +1. also add a regression test: keigo-preserve and rtl-bracket cases to the model-onboard smoke suite. If it fails, block int8 rollout.

sasha: good call. Jun — can you run the kernel diffs with svmap to see whether any store/load is misaligned on mixed-dir inputs? My hunch is an alignment shift in the transposed matmul causing occasional zero tokens.

jun: on it. ETA 2h. I'll also run the high-precision trace to see where token 0 is sampled.

mia: for tracking: created issue #ML-1732 with sample inputs and metrics, and linked PR with test harness. (link: https://redwood-internal/p/ML-1732)

luis: if we confirm kernel bug, roll back matmul v3 for int8 and add stricter preflight for mixed-direction locale smoke.

tao: agree. Also notify docs/devex that keigo-preservation is now a smoke criterion for ja models.

mia: thanks all — i'll paste updates here after jun's trace. :pray:

sasha: thanks, team. small action items: jun (kernel trace), luis (detok guard PR), tao (smoke tests), mia (issue + samples). We'll reconvene after traces.

mia: ack."
